1479-2638-2841-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2638-2841-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3534-7084-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
You control seven or more lands with different names.
3534-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
3534-7084-8095.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.

277-4094-4772-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-4094-4772-7824-7942.description:

When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

670-1619-2719-2897.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-2897.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Gigantoplasm and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-2897.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-4053-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1753-3259-4053-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

Repeat from step 5.

Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering All-Fates Stalker's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second All-Fates Stalker trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger from step 5, exiling Abdel Adrian until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Timeless Lotus.

2034-6414--6.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the undying creature, adding {C}{C}.

Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Korozda Gorgon abilities.
2034-6414--6.notes: This loop can be repeated whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control to reduce that creature's toughness to 0.

1636-2857-3734.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-3734.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {3}{U/P}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Phyrexian Metamorph to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Abhorrent Overlord token and the Harpy tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Repeat from step 2.

1634-3160-3858.manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {1}{W} for each opponent as needed

Resolve Call the Coppercoats, creating at least five 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times, doubling its power that many times, causing its power to be at least 32 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.
